Invoice Date.name: sale_invoice_date
Invoice Date.description: Date of the invoice (the sales fact's primary date).

Order Date.name: ord_order_date
Order Date.description: Date the order was placed (the orders fact's primary date).

Customer.name: c_customer
Customer.description: Customer as recorded at the time of sale. Also called: client, account, store, buyer.

Bill-To Customer.name: bc_customer
Bill-To Customer.description: Customer responsible for payment (role of the Customer dimension). Also called: bill to, billing customer, payer, head office.

City.name: ci_city
City.description: Delivery city as recorded at the time of sale; Sales Territory is an alternate hierarchy over State Province. Also called: location, territory, sales territory, state, region.

Sales Territory.name: ci_sales_territory
Sales Territory.description: Sales territory of the city as recorded at the time of the fact; alternate hierarchy over State Province.

WWI Stock Item ID.name: si_wwi_stock_item_id
WWI Stock Item ID.description: Durable stock item id, stable across SCD2 versions.

Stock Item.name: si_stock_item
Stock Item.description: Product as recorded at the time of sale (SCD Type 2); current attributes via the durable item id. Also called: product, item, SKU, article.

Color.name: si_color
Color.description: Stock item color as recorded at the time of the fact (as-was, SCD2).

Current Stock Item.name: csi_stock_item
Current Stock Item.description: Stock item name in its current version (as-is).

Current Color.name: csi_color
Current Color.description: Stock item color in its current version (as-is, SCD2).

Stock Group.name: sg_stock_group_name
Stock Group.description: Product group; an item can belong to several groups, so group totals overlap. Also called: category, product group, product category, department.

Salesperson.name: sp_employee
Salesperson.description: Employee credited with the sale or order (role of the Employee dimension). Also called: sales rep, seller, account manager, rep.

Picker.name: pk_employee
Picker.description: Employee who picked the order (role of the Employee dimension); applies to orders only. Also called: warehouse picker, picked by, fulfiller.

Revenue (Excl. Tax).name: m_revenue
Revenue (Excl. Tax).description: Sum of invoice line totals excluding tax (fact_sale.total_excluding_tax), dated by invoice date. Also called: revenue, sales, net sales, sales revenue, turnover, revenue excluding tax.

Revenue Including Tax.name: m_revenue_including_tax
Revenue Including Tax.description: Sum of invoice line totals including tax (fact_sale.total_including_tax). Also called: gross revenue incl tax, revenue with tax, total including tax, invoiced amount.

Gross Profit.name: m_gross_profit
Gross Profit.description: Sum of invoice line profit (fact_sale.profit). Also called: profit, margin dollars, gross margin amount.

Units Sold.name: m_units_sold
Units Sold.description: Sum of invoiced quantity (fact_sale.quantity). Also called: quantity sold, sold units, sales quantity, units invoiced.

Invoice Count.name: m_invoice_count
Invoice Count.description: Exact count of distinct invoices (fact_sale.wwi_invoice_id). Not additive across any dimension. Also called: number of invoices, invoices, distinct invoices.

Gross Margin %.name: m_gross_margin_pct
Gross Margin %.description: Gross Profit divided by Revenue (Excl. Tax), computed from the aggregated numerator and denominator at every grain. Also called: margin, gross margin, GM%, margin percent, profit margin.

Ordered Quantity.name: m_ordered_quantity
Ordered Quantity.description: Sum of ordered quantity (fact_order.quantity), dated by order date. Also called: units ordered, order quantity, quantity ordered, demand.

Backordered Order Lines.name: m_backordered_order_lines
Backordered Order Lines.description: Count of order lines with a backorder (fact_order.wwi_backorder_id is not null); blank when no line qualifies. Also called: backorders, backordered lines, lines on backorder.

Stock Group Revenue Share.name: m_stock_group_revenue_share
Stock Group Revenue Share.description: Revenue of items in a stock group divided by revenue of the same context without the stock group filter. Items can belong to several groups, so shares do not add to 100%. Denominator: revenue of the same context with Stock Group removed, counting each line once. Also called: category share, group share, share of revenue, revenue mix.

Sales Line Count.name: m_sales_line_count
Sales Line Count.description: Number of invoice lines in context (row presence of the sales fact).

Order Line Count.name: m_order_line_count
Order Line Count.description: Number of order lines in context (row presence of the orders fact).

Revenue (All Stock Groups).name: m_revenue_all_stock_groups
Revenue (All Stock Groups).description: Revenue of the current context with Stock Group removed; each invoice line counted once. The denominator of Stock Group Revenue Share.

RLS Territory Filter.name: rls_wwi_territory
RLS Territory Filter.description: Row-level security: members of the Southeast territory group see Southeast sales and orders only.

Snapshot Date.name: stk_snapshot_date
Snapshot Date.description: Date of the daily stock snapshot.

Balance Basis.name: stk_balance_basis
Balance Basis.description: How the daily balance was derived: holding_backcast or flow_min_opening (SPEC § 5.3 rule 6).

WWI Stock Item ID.name: si_wwi_stock_item_id
WWI Stock Item ID.description: Durable stock item id, stable across SCD2 versions.

Stock Item.name: si_stock_item
Stock Item.description: Product as recorded at the time of sale (SCD Type 2); current attributes via the durable item id. Also called: product, item, SKU, article.

Color.name: si_color
Color.description: Stock item color as recorded at the time of the fact (as-was, SCD2).

Current Stock Item.name: csi_stock_item
Current Stock Item.description: Stock item name in its current version (as-is).

Current Color.name: csi_color
Current Color.description: Stock item color in its current version (as-is, SCD2).

Stock Group.name: sg_stock_group_name
Stock Group.description: Product group; an item can belong to several groups, so group totals overlap. Also called: category, product group, product category, department.

Period End Snapshot Date.name: x_period_end
Period End Snapshot Date.description: Last snapshot date of the period in context, ignoring item and group attributes in the view.

Closing Stock On Hand.name: m_closing_stock
Closing Stock On Hand.description: Units on hand on the last day of the period (semi-additive); summed across stock items and stock groups. Value on the last snapshot date of the period in context. Also called: stock on hand, inventory, closing inventory, ending inventory, units in stock.

Units Sold Trailing 91 Days.name: m_units_sold_91d
Units Sold Trailing 91 Days.description: Units sold in the 91 days ending on the last snapshot date of the period, for the items in context; blank when no unit sold.

Days of Supply.name: m_days_of_supply
Days of Supply.description: Closing Stock On Hand divided by average daily Units Sold over the 91 days ending on the period end. Defined only by date and stock item attributes. Also called: DOS, days of inventory, inventory cover, stock cover, weeks of supply.

Snapshot Row Count.name: m_snapshot_rows
Snapshot Row Count.description: Number of item-day snapshot rows in context (row presence of the stock fact).

Closing Snapshot Date.name: m_closing_date
Closing Snapshot Date.description: Last snapshot date of the period in context (the date closing stock is taken on).

RLS Inventory Filter.name: rls_wwi_inventory
RLS Inventory Filter.description: Row-level security: the Southeast territory group has no inventory access.

Vendor.name: trip_vendor_id
Vendor.description: TLC technology provider id that recorded the trip. Also called: vendor id, provider, TPEP provider.

Pickup Timestamp.name: trip_pickup_ts
Pickup Timestamp.description: Pickup date and time (incremental extract key).

Pickup Date.name: trip_pickup_date
Pickup Date.description: Date the trip started; the anchor for year-to-date and pace metrics. Also called: trip date, pickup day, date.

Dropoff Date.name: trip_dropoff_date
Dropoff Date.description: Date the trip ended (role of the Date dimension); differs from pickup date for trips crossing midnight. Also called: dropoff day, trip end date, arrival date.

Pickup Hour.name: trip_pickup_hour
Pickup Hour.description: Hour of day the trip started, 0-23. Also called: hour, time of day, hour of day.

Pickup Zone.name: pz_zone
Pickup Zone.description: TLC taxi zone where the trip started (role of the Zone dimension). Also called: origin, pickup location, pickup borough, from.

Dropoff Zone.name: dz_zone
Dropoff Zone.description: TLC taxi zone where the trip ended (role of the Zone dimension). Also called: destination, dropoff location, dropoff borough, to.

Payment Type.name: pt_payment_type_name
Payment Type.description: TLC payment type code and label (0 Flex Fare trip, 1 Credit card, 2 Cash, 3 No charge, 4 Dispute, 5 Unknown, 6 Voided trip). Also called: payment method, paid by, tender.

Dropoff Year.name: dropoff_year
Dropoff Year.description: Calendar year of the dropoff date.

Dropoff Month Start Date.name: dropoff_month_start
Dropoff Month Start Date.description: First day of the dropoff month.

Trip Count.name: m_trip_count
Trip Count.description: Count of valid Yellow Taxi trips (fact_trip rows). Also called: trips, number of trips, rides, ride count.

Total Trip Distance.name: m_total_trip_distance
Total Trip Distance.description: Sum of trip distance in miles (fact_trip.trip_distance). Also called: miles, distance, total miles, trip miles.

Fare Amount.name: m_fare_amount
Fare Amount.description: Sum of metered fares (fact_trip.fare_amount), excluding tips, tolls and surcharges. Also called: fares, metered fare, fare revenue.

Tip Amount (All Payment Types).name: m_tip_amount
Tip Amount (All Payment Types).description: Sum of recorded tips across all payment types (fact_trip.tip_amount). TLC records tips only for card payments. Also called: tips, all tips, gratuity.

Tolls Amount.name: m_tolls_amount
Tolls Amount.description: Sum of tolls (fact_trip.tolls_amount). Also called: tolls, toll charges, bridge and tunnel tolls.

Gross Trip Revenue.name: m_gross_trip_revenue
Gross Trip Revenue.description: Sum of total amount charged (fact_trip.total_amount). Also called: revenue, trip revenue, total amount, gross revenue, takings.

Card Tips.name: m_card_tips
Card Tips.description: Sum of tips on credit card trips (payment type 1); blank for other payment types. Also called: credit card tips, card gratuity, tips on card.

Distinct OD Pairs.name: m_distinct_od_pairs
Distinct OD Pairs.description: Exact count of distinct pickup zone to dropoff zone pairs. Additive across zone and borough of either role; not additive across time, payment type, vendor or hour. Also called: origin destination pairs, OD pairs, unique routes, distinct routes.

Fare per Mile.name: m_fare_per_mile
Fare per Mile.description: Fare Amount divided by Total Trip Distance, computed from the aggregated sums at every grain. Also called: fare per mile, price per mile, rate per mile.

Revenue YTD.name: m_revenue_ytd
Revenue YTD.description: Gross Trip Revenue from 1 January to the period end by pickup date, compared with the same period last year (29 February maps to 28 February). Year-to-date through the As-of Date parameter. Also called: year to date revenue, YTD revenue, YoY growth, year over year, same time last year.

Revenue YTD Same Time Last Year.name: m_revenue_stly_ytd
Revenue YTD Same Time Last Year.formula: SUM(IF [trip_pickup_date] >= DATE(DATEADD('year', -1, DATETRUNC('year', [p_as_of_date]))) AND [trip_pickup_date] <= DATE(DATEADD('year', -1, [p_as_of_date])) THEN [trip_total_amount] END)
Revenue YTD Same Time Last Year.description: Revenue YTD one year before the As-of Date (29 February maps to 28 February).

Revenue YoY % vs STLY.name: m_revenue_yoy_pct
Revenue YoY % vs STLY.description: Year-over-year change of Revenue YTD against the same period last year.

Trips MTD.name: m_trips_mtd
Trips MTD.description: Trips from the first day of the As-of Date's month through the As-of Date.

Trips YTD.name: m_trips_ytd
Trips YTD.description: Trips from 1 January of the As-of Date's year through the As-of Date.

As-of Day of Month.name: as_of_day_of_month
As-of Day of Month.description: Calendar days elapsed in the As-of Date's month.

As-of Day of Year.name: as_of_day_of_year
As-of Day of Year.description: Calendar days elapsed in the As-of Date's year.

MTD-to-YTD Daily Pace Index.name: m_pace_index
MTD-to-YTD Daily Pace Index.description: Average daily trips month-to-date divided by average daily trips year-to-date, using calendar days elapsed. Above 1 means the month is running ahead of the year's pace. Anchored on the As-of Date parameter. Also called: pace index, run rate index, month pace, daily pace.

RLS Pickup Borough Filter.name: rls_nyc_pickup
RLS Pickup Borough Filter.description: Row-level security: the Manhattan pickup group sees trips picked up in Manhattan only.

As-of Date.name: p_as_of_date
As-of Date.description: Anchor date for year-to-date, same-time-last-year and month-to-date measures.
